```python
m_i = -float('inf')
d_i = 0.0
acc = gl.zeros(...)

for i in range(num_blocks):
    x = load_block(i)
    m_new = gl.max(x)
    d_new = gl.sum(gl.exp(x - m_new))

    alpha = gl.exp(m_i - m_new)
    acc = acc * alpha + gl.exp(x - m_new)
    d_i = d_i * alpha + d_new
    m_i = m_new

output = acc / d_i
```
